verification.validation: Compose planner, Prepare, storage-init binary and runtime tests pass as a non-root user (UID 65534), including undeclared and unlimited tmpfs refusal, bounded declared tmpfs (default, Compose and declared sizes), disk scratch planning, explicit 0700 creation with umask 0, start-time emptying without following symlinks, and storage_init on root-owned Shared Folder fixtures (mode 0777 without sticky bit, group grant, administrator-created subdirectory). Both npm packages are built and packed for content scans. No full gate matrix, qemu, publication or NAS acceptance is implied.

changes: Give Compose services disk scratch (compose.services.<service>.scratch): an SDK-created package-UID 0700 directory in the installed package files, emptied on every container start and removed with the package.
Refuse undeclared Compose tmpfs mounts and unlimited (size 0) tmpfs; every declared tmpfs gets the declared size, else the Compose size, else 64 MiB.
Let storage_init create package subdirectories in a selected Shared Folder owned by DSM or an administrator, without changing the folder or requiring ownership.
